title: Alweda Aye Hussain Aye Hussain Alweda
body:
alvida aye hussain aye hussain alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
aye rasoole mukkaram ke chain alvida
1. zeenat-e- do jahan hai tere naksh-e-pa
tere sajde kiye magrabain alvida
<<MINI>>
alvida aye hussain aye hussain alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
2. majlise teri har ghar mein ho jalwagar
tujhko roti hai duniya hussain alvida
<<MINI>>
alvida aye hussain aye hussain alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
3. chandni raat par murdani chaagayi
khogaya chand taaron ka chain alvida
<<MINI>>
alvida aye hussain aye hussain alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
4. sarkhule fatima aarahi hai nazar
ro rahe hai shahe mashra khain alvida
<<MINI>>
alvida aye hussain aye hussain alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
5. hum jiyegein toh agle baras royenge phir se hoga yahi shor -o- shain alvida
<<MINI>>
